turns.tenant_message: Please replace blanket full-deposit forfeiture with documented reasonable loss. For the INR 3000 cleaning charge, please provide an itemised invoice.
turns.reply: Under Indian Contract Act, 1872 Section 74, a stipulated penalty must support only reasonable compensation and not exceed the stipulated amount. I will retain the deposit forfeiture clause as agreed, but I will provide documentation of any loss incurred in the event of a breach to demonstrate that the forfeiture is reasonable. I will also provide an itemised invoice for the INR 3000 cleaning charge upon your departure.
